SELECT TAB.NUNOTA ,TAB.NUMNOTA ,TAB.CODPROD ,TAB.SEQUENCIA ,TAB.BASEICMS ,TAB.VLRICMS ,TAB.CODCFO ,TAB.NR_PEDIDO ,(SELECT C.AD_NUNOTASAI FROM TGFCAB C WHERE C.NUNOTA = TAB.NR_PEDIDO ) AS TRANSFERENCIA ,(SELECT SUM(I.VLRICMS) FROM TGFITE I WHERE I.NUNOTA = (SELECT CASE WHEN TAB.NR_PEDIDO = 708606 AND CODPROD = 3125030 THEN 708992 ELSE C.AD_NUNOTASAI END FROM TGFCAB C WHERE C.NUNOTA = TAB.NR_PEDIDO ) AND I.CODPROD = TAB.CODPROD) AS ICMS_ORIGEM
FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA ,CAB.NUMNOTA ,ITE.CODPROD ,ITE.SEQUENCIA ,ITE.BASEICMS ,ITE.VLRICMS ,ITE.CODCFO ,(SELECT MAX(VAR.NUNOTAORIG) FROM TGFVAR VAR WHERE VAR.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA ) AS NR_PEDIDO
FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 2 AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND CAB.TIPMOV ='V' )TAB
